From: Daniel Rowe <daniel.rowe@acme-analytics.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-05T15:23:00-07:00
Subject: Zonal fencing & control-plane annotations for Dedicated/Private deployments

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Acme's SIG intake and upcoming SOC 2 evidence collection, we need a short deliverable package that explains how Redwood isolates tenant workloads across Dedicated and Private deployments. Specifically we'd like: 

1) An annotated network diagram showing zones (control plane, data plane, management), per-zone egress rules, and where customer-managed VPCs attach for Private deployments.
2) A separate callout for the control-plane data flows (what services are in the control plane, how the orchestration plane communicates with dedicated GPUs, and authentication/authorization boundaries).
3) Example egress ACLs / iptables snippets or security group templates for common cloud providers (we operate in us-west-2).
4) KMS/boundary note showing where customer keys are used vs Redwood-managed keys and which requests are logged to audit trails.
5) A short narrative (~1 page) explaining failure scenarios and graceful degradation (e.g., if Dedicated pool in a zone is drained, how requests are routed/fallbacks).
6) Any redactions or non-exportable items we should be aware of (we cannot circulate raw ASN ranges or internal hostnames).

Can you confirm a timeline? We are targeting SIG submission by Oct 26 and would like to include this material.

Best,
Daniel
Security Program Manager
Acme Analytics
